name: Roleplay v2 Rehearsal Judge — Agent Test Case Evaluator
description: Evaluates ONE agent test case (condition + test) against ONE rehearsal transcript, judging the runtime (actor + director), not the scripted CONDITION_DRIVEN trainee. Two-step protocol: verify the condition genuinely occurred (else INCONCLUSIVE), then check the test assertion (PASSED/FAILED) with verbatim [turn N] evidence. Contains literal JSON braces, so the runtime resolves it via load_template and appends the spec manually; condition_recreated=false deterministically forces INCONCLUSIVE after the LLM call.
